nina_devex: Heads-up: Found a weird parity bug between Node + Python SDKs with the next-starter sample. Streaming generation truncates at ~512 tokens on Node, but Python streams full output. Also auth retry loop after token refresh sometimes returns 401 repeatedly.
sam_dev: uh oh. can you paste minimal repro and env?
nina_devex: repro steps:
1) clone github.com/redwood-inference/next-starter-lite
2) yarn && yarn dev
3) call /api/generate with a long prompt
Observed: Node SDK stream ends early. Logs show 'stream closed by peer' + repeated 401 during refresh
snippet:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.chat.stream({ model: 'rw/long-model', messages });
```
Env: NEXT_PUBLIC_RDW_REGION=us-west1, SDK@0.7.2 (node), python-sdk@0.12.1 works
leo_infra: Interesting. Did you test with keepalive off/on? We had an issue where Node http2 agent pool closes idle streams early. Try setting RDW_HTTP_KEEPALIVE=true and bumping connection timeout.
eva_research: Also saw function-calling role mismatch — Node sets role='assistant' incorrectly during chunked function calls which confuses kernel selection. Opening ticket INF-4821.
sam_dev: Can you share logs lines for the 401? is it 401 from auth service or from model shard?
nina_devex: 401 from auth proxy: 'token expired', then client retries immediately but gets 401 again. Workaround: restart dev server or clear auth cache. Repro attached as gist: https://gist.github.com/nina/abc123
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary for next-starter-lite failed on canary-3 with healthcheck timeout at 1719012389
leo_infra: :thumbsup: I'll try a local repro with keepalive tweak. If that fails, we can add exponential backoff on refresh token path.
maria_engops: If this is real, might impact hosted customers using JS SDK. I'll open an advisory if INF-4821 shows rollback risk.
nina_devex: Created PR draft with a repro + temporary fix (increase stream timeout, backoff) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-starter-lite/pull/92
Plan: fix SDK handshake in node runtime + add e2e test vs python stream parity.
sam_dev: Assign to @leo_infra for triage. Thanks!
